fields.label: Location
fields.note: confirmed: ?location=bengaluru returns exactly the 10 bengaluru rows of 14

notes: CRED's official openings UI (careers.cred.club/careers/openings) reads a Lever-shaped board proxy, GET https://kong-web-prod.dreamplug.in/lever-jobs-api/v1/jobs, which returns {data:[...14 published rows...]} with categories {team, department, location, commitment}, workplaceType, createdAt and urls.show/apply on jobs.lever.co/cred/<uuid>. The endpoint honours ?location=<value> server-side (14 rows unfiltered -> 10 rows with ?location=bengaluru, exactly the bengaluru subset), so location is a native filter; ?department=data%20science returned 0 rows although one posting has that department, so department has no usable parameter and the remaining facets (team, commitment, workplaceType) are unconfirmed - those, plus the page's own client-side exclusion of department 'prefr', are applied locally.
